The build of #40362 has been going for 6 hours and seems stuck at the install bibtools. This does't seem right. Can someone take a look?

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/actions/runs/32225884086/job/95985376566?pr=40362

This happens from time to time, I think it could just be some network error or something on GitHub's side. I went ahead and retriggered the job, but note that that job is not required to pass for your PR to be merged by bors. Since your PR has been delegated to you, you can also just go ahead and comment bors r+ on it as well if you're done making changes.
